title: Integrator (Discrete or Continuous)
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time integrator, 3 inputs, 1 output, {External reset} sets Reset strategy; {Integrator method} sets the option to specify integration or accumulation method Integration: Forward, {Limit type} sets the saturation strategy, {Upper saturation limit} sets the state upper limit, {Lower saturation limit} sets the state lower limit and {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets the block sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Integrator method
params.values: Option to specify integration or accumulation method Integration: Forward Euler (default) | Integration: Backward Euler | Integration: Trapezoidal | Accumulation: Forward Euler | Accumulation: Backward Euler | Accumulation: Trapezoidal

params.name: External reset
params.values: Reset strategy level (default) | rising | falling | either

params.name: Upper saturation limit
params.values: State upper limit inf (default) | real number
